title: Aetherium configuration file (aetherium.json)
description: Generated by tools/gen_resources.py from common/src/main/java/com/aetherium/config/AetheriumConfig.java. Do not edit by hand: the engine reads the same field list reflectively, so this file is the schema of a real contract, not a copy of it. additionalProperties=true everywhere because unknown keys are preserved verbatim on save (a modpack's tuning must never be destroyed by a downgrade).

version.description: File format version. ConfigStore#migrate handles v1 -> v2 -> v3.

advanced.conflict_auto_delegate.description: Hand features back to a conflicting mod instead of double-applying them.

advanced.debug_logging.description: Enable dev-level logging (hot-path cost: near zero when off).

advanced.experimental_full_renderer.description: NOT SHIPPED. Setting this true is refused at startup: an error is logged and the engine runs in shadow (Compatibility) mode. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, "Honest status".

advanced.fail_fast_gpu.description: Crash with a report instead of falling back to Compatibility mode.

advanced.gl_errors.description: Check glGetError at pass boundaries in debug builds.

advanced.strict_mixins.description: require=1 on every injection, so a version delta that no longer matches fails the launch instead of silently skipping.

android.battery_saver.description: Cap FPS, halve upload budget, stop background meshing on battery.

android.enabled.description: Enable launcher/renderer probing. No-op on desktop.

android.force_renderer.description: Override the detected renderer; use when the launcher env is unreadable.

android.memory_budget_mb.description: Soft ceiling for native arenas; auto-detected from cgroup limits when 0.

android.mobile_memory.description: Shrink arenas, mesh cache and texture mips to the heap budget.

android.read_custom_env.description: Parse the launcher's custom_env.txt for renderer hints.

android.thermal_ceiling_c.description: Package temperature at which Aetherium starts shedding work.

android.thermal_throttle.description: Read thermal zones and back off before the SoC clocks down.

android.touch_mode.description: 48dp hit targets, swipe scroll, long-press tooltips.

general.enabled.description: Master switch. false = Compatibility mode (vanilla renderer), live, no restart.

general.hud.backend_tag.description: Append [Aetherium/GL46] to the F3 header line.

general.hud.corner.description: Overlay anchor: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right.

general.hud.frame_graph.description: Spike graph of the last 240 frames.

general.notify_conflicts.description: Show a notice on screen (top-right, under the backend tag) when a conflicting renderer mod is present.

performance.async_meshing.description: Mesh sections off-thread with distance priority.

performance.backend.description: Backend selection. AUTO probes the GPU and picks the best available.

performance.hzb.levels.description: Pyramid depth; larger = cheaper tests, coarser rejection.

performance.indirect_batch_capacity.description: Draw-command slots allocated up front; the GPU-visible count decides how many are used.

performance.mesh_workers.description: 0 = auto (min(availableProcessors()-1, 8)). Applies on next world load.

performance.persistent_buffers.description: Persistent mapped buffers with triple buffering + fences.

performance.program_cache.description: Disk-cache GL program binaries (skips recompiles across launches).

performance.target_fps.description: 0 = uncapped. Soft cap applied after the swap; never blocks the render thread.

performance.upload_budget_kb.description: Per-frame ceiling on mapped-buffer uploads; keeps upload spikes out of the frame graph.

quality.entity_culling.description: Frustum + occlusion culling of entity render dispatches.

quality.max_direct_light.description: Maximum direct block light written to the lightmap.

quality.weather.description: Rain/snow quality; FAST also silences weather particle churn.

shaders.iris_integration.description: Bind the Iris/Oculus v0 API by reflection when present.

shaders.pause_dynamic_lights_with_shader.description: Disable dynamic lightmap writes while a shader pack owns the lightmap.

shaders.reload_on_world_change.description: Re-apply pack options on dimension/world change.

utilities.dynamic_lights.colored.description: Use per-source RGB instead of a white falloff.

utilities.dynamic_lights.enabled.description: Item/entity light sources written into the lightmap.

utilities.dynamic_lights.entities.description: Light from entities holding a light source.

utilities.dynamic_lights.quality.description: 0 off, 1 sources only, 2 + attenuation smoothing, 3 + occlusion test.

utilities.gamma.amount.description: Full-brightness slider; 20.0 is the cave-vision ceiling.

utilities.gamma.cave_vision.description: Raise the block-light floor only while the camera is under skylight 0.

utilities.gamma.cave_vision_floor.description: Effective block light guaranteed by cave vision.

utilities.gamma.curve.description: Monotone control points 'x:y,...' — see gamma.GammaCurve; blank disables the curve editor.

utilities.gamma.enabled.description: Override the vanilla lightmap gamma response.

utilities.gamma.night_vision.description: Brighten the sky-light channel at night without changing block light.

utilities.gamma.night_vision_level.description: Sky-light floor applied by night vision boost.

utilities.gamma.time_based.description: Blend gamma between a day and a night target using world time.

utilities.gamma.time_based_night.description: Gamma applied at midnight when time-based gamma is on.
